content.title: BRAVES.TV
content.text: How to Watch the Braves in 2026 FAQ What is BravesVision? BravesVision is your new home for Atlanta Braves baseball for the 2026 season! BravesVision will produce more than 140 games, as well as extensive pre-game and post-game programming throughout the 2026 regular season for fans across the Braves six state territory. Will BravesVision broadcast all Braves games in the local market, as was previously done with FanDuel Sports Network South and FanDuel Sports Network Southeast? Yes. Locally distributed Braves games are produced and distributed under the name BravesVision for the 2026 season. The Braves will oversee production, sales, marketing, and distribution of local television broadcasts. Where can I find BravesVision on my cable, satellite or streaming service provider? BravesVision is available on numerous cable, satellite, and streaming services, including: Xfinity (channel 1254) DIRECTV (channel 645) Spectrum Fubo U-Verse (channel 1730) And multiple providers throughout Braves Country. The full lineup can be found here Will my cable, satellite or streaming provider carry BravesVision? The Braves have partnered with cable, satellite, and streaming services to provide BravesVision to their customers, including Xfinity, Spectrum, Fubo and U-Verse. YouTube TV has indicated they will not carry BravesVision, so the best option for YouTube TV customers in the Braves television market is to purchase a Braves.TV streaming package. For more information on BravesVision, contact your cable, satellite or streaming service provider. Will I be able to stream Braves games? BravesVision telecasts will be available on Braves.TV, a new streaming platform from Major League Baseball. With a subscription, all regular season non-national exclusive Braves games will be available to fans everywhere within the Braves television market with NO BLACKOUTS! How much does Braves.TV cost? A season subscription to Braves.TV, featuring live and on-demand streaming on over 140 regular season Braves games with no local blackouts is available for $99.99. A monthly subscription is available for $19.99. Is there a Braves.TV or BravesVision app? I can’t find it in my app store. Braves.TV is a service that streams Braves games airing on BravesVision and is accessible through the MLB app. When you’re in your app store, you’ll need to search for the MLB app, not Braves.TV. Which devices will I be able to access Braves.TV from? Fans can stream Braves.TV on a variety of devices through the MLB app. You can find the full list of devices here: Click here for MLB App Devices. I live within the Braves television market - are there any blackouts on Braves.TV? No local blackouts! In-market Braves.TV subscribers can stream ALL local Braves broadcasts on BravesVision with no blackouts. Subject to national exclusivities. How do I stream Braves games in the local area? Braves.TV subscribers are able to access available Braves games in the Braves home territory with no blackouts when they are at home and when they are traveling, subject to national exclusive telecasts and local blackout restrictions in other home markets. This applies only to subscribers in the Braves home television territory and is a separate service than the MLB.TV out-of-market package. I live in either the Mets, Phillies, Nationals or Marlins home television area. Does that mean Braves games vs. each of these NL East teams will be blacked out for me if I purchase Braves.TV/Atlanta Braves MLB.TV Single Team package? That’s up to 13 games I’d miss. Yes – however, in order to guarantee no blackouts (unless a game is broadcast by a national broadcaster), you would need to purchase the MLB.TV/Club.TV bundle for $199.99/season or $39.99/month. So, if you live in the Nationals home television area, you’d need to purchase the MLB.TV/Nationals.TV bundle, or if you live in Miami you’d need to purchase the MLB.TV/Marlins.TV bundle. I'm a Braves.TV subscriber who lives in the Braves local territory but I'm traveling out of the Braves market. Can I still watch games on Braves.TV? Braves.TV subscribers who are traveling outside of the Braves home territory can still watch Braves games while traveling and are only subject to the opposing team’s local blackout restrictions, if applicable. So, if you’re visiting Washington, D.C. and the Braves are playing the Marlins, you will be able to watch the game if it’s on BravesVision. However, if you’re visiting Washington, D.C. and the Braves are playing the Nationals, you are subject to a blackout restriction. Can MLB.TV All Teams subscribers watch Braves games on MLB.TV in the Atlanta Braves television market? Only users that have specifically purchased the 2026 Braves.TV package or the Braves.TV/MLB.TV bundle subscription will be able to stream Braves games in the local area. MLB.TV All Teams subscribers will NOT have access and must purchase Braves.TV in order to stream Braves games in the home market. Can I authenticate access to Braves games through the MLB.TV app by using the credentials from my pay-TV provider? Authentication information from your pay-TV provider will be available once distributor deals are finalized. Will I be able to watch Braves games if I have a standard MLB.TV package, but not the Braves.TV package? If you already have the MLB app downloaded, you’re one step closer to watching Braves baseball! Braves fans living within the Braves home television territory must purchase a Braves.TV subscription to stream Braves games. Only fans who live outside the Braves home market will be able to watch Braves games with the standard MLB.TV package. But remember, when the Braves play the team in your home television territory, the game would be blacked out on MLB.TV How do I know if I live in the Braves home territory? A map of the Atlanta Braves home television territory is below. Can I watch Braves.TV through the ESPN app? Currently ESPN only offers the out-of-market MLB.TV service. In 2026, in-market Braves.TV games will be available for streaming in the MLB app and not available in-market on the ESPN app. Will select Braves games still be simulcast on over-the-air stations like they were in 2025? For the second consecutive season, the Braves have partnered with Gray Media to simulcast a select number of regular season games over-the-air (OTA) for free in Atlanta and across the Southeast through Gray’s network of broadcast stations. For a list of Gray Media stations in Braves Country, visit bravesongray.com. Blackout Policy Due to certain Major League Baseball national exclusivities, select regular season, special event, and Postseason games are unavailable on MLB.TV domestically and internationally. Live audio of all 30 MLB teams is included with Braves.TV subscriptions. Purchasers of Braves.TV have access to in-market live-streaming games: click here for full details. Web: Select the Atlanta Braves game you wish to view from the Multimedia Center. You will be prompted to enter your Username and Password. As long as the computer meets the system requirements then you can log in with your registered email address and password to access your subscription from anywhere at any time. Sharing of your username and password is strictly prohibited. For more information, please click here. Mobile & Connected Devices To watch Atlanta Braves games on mobile and connected devices, download the MLB app and select the game you wish to view. You will be prompted to enter your Username and Password. Sharing of your username and password is strictly prohibited. For more information, please click here. Device Availability For a full list of supported devices click here Braves.TV Support If you are having issues accessing a game or have questions about your account you can visit our full online Support Page. You can also call our toll-free support (866.244.2291), email by clicking here, on Social @MLBFanSupport or via Virtual Assistant. Payment Methods Accepted payment methods include: MasterCard, Visa, American Express, Discover, Masterpass, and PayPal. Please note: The payment and billing information entered above will be stored as your primary payment card in the Manage Subscriptions section of your MLB Account. If you save alternative payment cards to the Manage Subscriptions section of your MLB Account, you authorize us to charge such payment card(s) in the event we are unable to process charges to the primary payment card entered above. If the account number, expiration date or debit card account associated with your subscription changes, update it as soon as possible. Please also be aware, MLB may acquire this current information from our financial services partner(s) and update the Manage Subscriptions section of your MLB Account to include such revised payment information. Free Trial Policy You may cancel a 7-day risk-free trial of Braves.TV Yearly or Braves.TV Monthly any time during the 7-day window and will still have access to Braves.TV for the full 7 days. If you do not cancel, you will be billed on the eighth day for the current Yearly or Monthly subscription price. MLB reserves the right to determine customer eligibility for trial memberships in its sole discretion. If you purchased the Braves.TV monthly subscription, the payment card you have on file with us will be billed monthly on approximately the same monthly date that you originally purchased, with monthly billing for each month of the 2026 MLB season through and including October. You can verify your monthly billing date in your MLB Account under “Manage Subscriptions.” Braves.TV GovX Discount Exclusive discount for current and former military. Customers receive a 35% discount to select Club.TV subscriptions. The discount can only be applied by selecting the GOVX option in the checkout flow. Braves.TV Cancellation Policy You may easily cancel your Braves.TV subscription any time before your next billing period in your MLB Account, under the Manage Subscriptions tab, or by contacting customer service at 866-244-2291 or contacting us here. (International Customers please call 315-203-6761). Braves.TV Auto-renewal Details Braves.TV Yearly: By clicking “Buy and accept terms,” you agree to the MLB.com Terms of Use and the MLB.com Privacy Policy. You also agree that your subscription to Braves.TV Yearly will automatically renew annually on or about March 1 at the then-current year’s regular full yearly price. You can cancel your automatic renewal any time before the billing period. Braves.TV Monthly: By clicking “Buy & Accept Terms,” you agree to the MLB.com Terms of Use and the MLB.com Privacy Policy. You also agree that your subscription to Braves.TV Monthly will renew monthly through and including October, and will automatically renew annually on or about March 1 each year at the then-current year’s regular full monthly price. You can cancel your automatic renewal any time before the billing period.
